description: Connect two related memories with a named relationship. Use this to build a knowledge graph — e.g., linking a bug fix to the architecture decision that caused it, or connecting a preference to the pattern it led to.

related_memory_id.description: The target memory ID to link to

relationship.description: How the memories relate: led_to (A caused B), contradicts (A conflicts with B), extends (A builds on B), related (general connection), rejected (A is the decision, B is the option considered and turned down; use this so a later session does not re-derive a path already ruled out)

name: link_memories
